metadata.//: Games are stored as an array of objects. Each object contains the details of a single game. All game times are stored in 24-hour format and in UK time. The 'home_score' and 'away_score' fields are to be left blank until the game has been played (then parsed as whole integers when not blank). The 'winner' field is to be left blank until the game has been played, and will contain either the home team name, away team name, or 'Draw'.
